source: hand-written from the sbx reference at https://docs.docker.com/reference/cli/sbx/ (docker/docs commit 09d7cacc), the Docker Sandboxes release notes for v0.48.0 and the maintainer's daily use of sbx; the argv shapes and the output of version and ls --json were checked against the help and ls output of sbx v0.49.2 on 2026-10-22 (the capturedAt date), and the other output shapes are assumed where the reference does not give them, and block A re-measures them; carried unchanged to the floor 0.51.0 on 2026-11-07, its shapes not yet checked against sbx 0.51, which block A re-measures
description: The reads romeu makes before it changes anything, on a host with no sandbox: sbx version, sbx ls --json, sbx policy ls --json and sbx env plan.
